LanguageData.DMS_Anchor.label: reality anchor
LanguageData.DMS_Anchor.description: A stabilization device that uses counter-technology to keep the surrounding space free from the influence of transcendent forces. To an ordinary person it is nothing more than a harmless decoration, but psycasters and transcendent artifacts find it hard to establish connections beyond this dimension in its presence, and cannot manifest their transcendent properties.
LanguageData.DMS_ZeroPointGenerator.label: zero-point generator core
LanguageData.DMS_ZeroPointGenerator.description: A complex device that punches a hole in real space through the controlled release of antigrain energy, drawing inexhaustible energy from the quantum fluctuations outside and condensing it into solid energy blocks for convenient storage and further processing.\n\nSince the rim generally lacks antigrain production technology, the device usually has to rely on ready-made antigrain warheads as the catalyst that starts it running.
